description: The factual ceiling for the script -- nothing in script.py may state a claim not traceable to an EvidenceItem here.

EvidenceItem_fields.source_ref: the synthesis_id or original finding reference
EvidenceItem_fields.claim_text: verbatim finding text from the specialist synthesis, e.g. 'DERIVED_METRIC: KBC classified INDIRECT (real estate sector, no facility-level confirmation)'
EvidenceItem_fields.claim_class: FACT | ANALYSIS | INTERPRETATION | HYPOTHESIS | UNVERIFIED -- mapped from the specialist institution's own leading tag via evidence_pack.py::_TAG_TO_CLAIM_CLASS, never re-classified upward

EvidencePack_fields.specialist_findings_refs: list[str] -- the specialist report_ids/input_report_ids that fed the synthesis
EvidencePack_fields.contradictions: list[str] -- verbatim contradictory finding text, both sides preserved
EvidencePack_fields.stale_evidence: list[str] -- from the synthesis's own temporal_mismatches
EvidencePack_fields.prohibited_extrapolations: list[str] -- fixed, disclosed rules, e.g. 'no specific numeric market forecast beyond what a FACT/ANALYSIS-class item states'
